{
  "ok": true,
  "tool": "list_operations",
  "operations": [
    {
      "op": "add_angular_dim",
      "category": "annotate",
      "summary": "Angular dimension from vertex 'center' between rays to p1 and p2 (measured CCW from p1 to p2); 'radius' places the dimension arc",
      "params": [
        "center*",
        "p1*",
        "p2*",
        "radius",
        "text",
        "text_height",
        "length_factor"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_arc",
      "category": "draw",
      "summary": "Draw a circular arc, counter-clockwise from start_angle to end_angle (degrees)",
      "params": [
        "center",
        "radius",
        "start_angle",
        "end_angle",
        "start",
        "mid",
        "end"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_circle",
      "category": "draw",
      "summary": "Draw a circle",
      "params": [
        "center*",
        "radius",
        "diameter"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_diameter_dim",
      "category": "annotate",
      "summary": "Diameter dimension of a circle/arc",
      "params": [
        "target",
        "center",
        "radius",
        "angle",
        "text",
        "text_height",
        "length_factor"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_ellipse",
      "category": "draw",
      "summary": "Draw an ellipse (or elliptical arc) by semi-axes rx, ry and rotation",
      "params": [
        "center*",
        "rx*",
        "ry*",
        "rotation",
        "start_angle",
        "end_angle"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_leader",
      "category": "annotate",
      "summary": "Leader (arrow polyline) with an MTEXT note at the last vertex",
      "params": [
        "points*",
        "text*",
        "text_height"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_line",
      "category": "draw",
      "summary": "Draw a straight line segment",
      "params": [
        "start*",
        "end*"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_linear_dim",
      "category": "annotate",
      "summary": "Linear dimension between two points",
      "params": [
        "p1*",
        "p2*",
        "orientation",
        "angle",
        "offset",
        "base",
        "text",
        "text_height",
        "length_factor"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_mtext",
      "category": "annotate",
      "summary": "Multi-line text (MTEXT)",
      "params": [
        "text*",
        "insert*",
        "char_height",
        "width"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_point",
      "category": "draw",
      "summary": "Draw a point entity",
      "params": [
        "location*"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_polyline",
      "category": "draw",
      "summary": "Draw a 2D polyline (LWPOLYLINE)",
      "params": [
        "points*",
        "closed"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_radius_dim",
      "category": "annotate",
      "summary": "Radius dimension of a circle/arc",
      "params": [
        "target",
        "center",
        "radius",
        "angle",
        "text",
        "text_height",
        "length_factor"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_rectangle",
      "category": "draw",
      "summary": "Draw an axis-aligned (optionally rotated) rectangle as a closed polyline",
      "params": [
        "corner",
        "center",
        "width*",
        "height*",
        "corner_radius",
        "rotation"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_spline",
      "category": "draw",
      "summary": "Draw a spline through fit points",
      "params": [
        "fit_points*",
        "degree"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_table",
      "category": "annotate",
      "summary": "Simple table drawn as grid lines + TEXT",
      "params": [
        "insert*",
        "rows*",
        "col_widths*",
        "row_height",
        "text_height"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_text",
      "category": "annotate",
      "summary": "Single-line text",
      "params": [
        "text*",
        "insert*",
        "height",
        "rotation",
        "align"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_title_block",
      "category": "annotate",
      "summary": "Insert the standard 180x32 mm title block (ISO-like) with attributes ['TITLE', 'DWG_NO', 'MATERIAL', 'SCALE', 'UNITS', 'DRAWN_BY', 'DATE', 'SHEET']",
      "params": [
        "insert*",
        "fields",
        "size_factor"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "add_viewport",
      "category": "layout",
      "summary": "Add a viewport to a paper-space layout (pass layout=<name>) that shows model space at a fixed scale",
      "params": [
        "center*",
        "scale*",
        "width",
        "height",
        "view_center"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "array_polar",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Polar array about a center: 'count' items (including the original) over 'total_angle'",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "center*",
        "count*",
        "total_angle",
        "rotate_items"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "array_rect",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Rectangular array: copies arranged in rows and columns (the original is cell [0,0])",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "rows*",
        "cols*",
        "row_spacing",
        "col_spacing"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "chamfer",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "AutoCAD CHAMFER of two LINEs with distances d1 (on line1) and d2 (on line2)",
      "params": [
        "line1*",
        "line2*",
        "d1*",
        "d2"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "copy",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Copy entities by a displacement; 'count' > 1 repeats the displacement cumulatively",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "delta",
        "base",
        "to",
        "count"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "create_layer",
      "category": "layer",
      "summary": "Create a layer (no-op with if_exists='skip')",
      "params": [
        "name*",
        "color",
        "linetype",
        "lineweight",
        "if_exists"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "create_layout",
      "category": "layout",
      "summary": "Create a paper-space layout (a printed sheet) with its paper size",
      "params": [
        "name*",
        "paper",
        "orientation",
        "width",
        "height",
        "if_exists"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "define_block",
      "category": "block",
      "summary": "Define (or redefine) a block from a list of draw operations and attribute definitions",
      "params": [
        "name*",
        "base_point",
        "entities*",
        "attributes",
        "if_exists"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "delete",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Erase entities",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "confirm_large"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "delete_layer",
      "category": "layer",
      "summary": "Delete a layer",
      "params": [
        "name*",
        "delete_entities"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "explode",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Explode block references (INSERT) or polylines into their component entities",
      "params": [
        "target*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "extend",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "AutoCAD EXTEND: lengthen a LINE end until it meets the nearest boundary edge",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "edges*",
        "end"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "fillet",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "AutoCAD FILLET of two LINEs: trims/extends both to tangency and adds a tangent ARC (radius 0 = sharp corner)",
      "params": [
        "line1*",
        "line2*",
        "radius*"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "insert_block",
      "category": "block",
      "summary": "Insert a block reference, filling attributes from 'attributes' {TAG: value}",
      "params": [
        "name*",
        "insert*",
        "scale",
        "rotation",
        "attributes"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "mirror",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Mirror entities about the line p1-p2",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "p1*",
        "p2*",
        "keep_original"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "modify",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Set fields of ONE entity, e.g",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "set*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "modify_layer",
      "category": "layer",
      "summary": "Change layer properties (color, linetype, lineweight, on, frozen, locked, rename)",
      "params": [
        "name*",
        "color",
        "linetype",
        "lineweight",
        "on",
        "frozen",
        "locked",
        "new_name"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "move",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Translate entities by a displacement (or from 'base' to 'to')",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "delta",
        "base",
        "to"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "offset",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Create an offset copy of a LINE, CIRCLE, ARC or straight-segment LWPOLYLINE",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "distance*",
        "side_point"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },
    {
      "op": "rotate",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Rotate entities about a center point (degrees, CCW)",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "angle*",
        "center*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "scale",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Uniformly scale entities about a base point",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "factor*",
        "center*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "set_annotation_scale",
      "category": "annotate",
      "summary": "Set the plot scale 1:scale for annotations: dimension arrows/text/gaps (DIMSCALE) and linetype dash lengths (LTSCALE) are multiplied by 'scale'",
      "params": [
        "scale*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "set_attributes",
      "category": "block",
      "summary": "Set attribute values of block references",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "values*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "set_properties",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Change layer / color / linetype / lineweight / tag of entities",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "layer",
        "color",
        "linetype",
        "lineweight",
        "tag"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "stretch",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "AutoCAD STRETCH with a crossing window: entities entirely inside move; LINE end points, polyline vertices and dimension definition points inside the window move; circles/arcs/text/blocks move if their center/insert point is inside",
      "params": [
        "window*",
        "delta*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "op": "trim",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "AutoCAD TRIM: remove the part of the target (LINE, ARC or CIRCLE) that contains 'pick', bounded by its nearest intersections with the cutting edges",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "edges*",
        "pick*"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "count": 43,
  "detail": false,
  "categories": [
    "annotate",
    "block",
    "draw",
    "edit",
    "layer",
    "layout"
  ],
  "common_params": {
    "all_ops": [
      "layout"
    ],
    "draw_params": [
      "color",
      "if_tag_exists",
      "layer",
      "linetype",
      "lineweight",
      "tag"
    ],
    "meaning": {
      "layout": "'Model' (default) or a paper-space layout name",
      "layer": "layer name, created if missing",
      "color": "ACI color, 256 = BYLAYER",
      "linetype": "e.g. CONTINUOUS, CENTER, DASHED",
      "lineweight": "1/100 mm, -1 = BYLAYER",
      "tag": "name for later reference as 'tag:<name>'",
      "if_tag_exists": "error | skip | replace"
    }
  },
  "constraint_types": {
    "check": [
      "angle",
      "coincident",
      "concentric",
      "diameter",
      "distance",
      "equal",
      "fixed",
      "horizontal",
      "length",
      "parallel",
      "perpendicular",
      "radius",
      "symmetric",
      "tangent",
      "vertical"
    ],
    "enforce": [
      "coincident",
      "concentric",
      "diameter",
      "distance",
      "equal",
      "fixed",
      "horizontal",
      "length",
      "parallel",
      "perpendicular",
      "radius",
      "vertical"
    ]
  },
  "hint": "Parameters marked * are required. Ops with draw_params also take layer, color, linetype, lineweight, tag, if_tag_exists; every op takes layout. For types, units, defaults and limits call list_operations(ops=[...]) or list_operations(category=...).",
  "metrics": {
    "duration_ms": 0.14,
    "input_bytes": 25,
    "output_bytes": 9473
  }
}

- 圆共 5 个，标注共 6 个
- "ACME"和"技术要求"文字都还在

**还不完善的地方**
- 新标注的文字在孔外左下方，约 (58.2, 25.9)；原有 4X Ø12 的标注文字在孔内。两者风格不完全一致，而且我没有出图看过，不确定和其他图元有没有视觉上的重叠。
- 新孔只标了直径，没有画中心线，也没有标到板边的定位尺寸。原有的孔也没有中心线，所以我保持了一致；如果需要，可以在后续轮次补上。
- 纸空间 Layout1 是空的，所以不需要同步修改。
